samples.body: Happy happy 25th wedding anniversary to us!!! 🎉 Ben, I don't know how you put up with me for 25 years, me who is always on call, always smelling of hand gel, always falling asleep in front of the telly before the news finish. Haha. When we got married in Iloilo we had nothing, we borrowed the car for the wedding from your Tito and it broke down on the way to the church, remember? I arrived 40 minutes late and your mother thought I changed my mind 😂 Then we came here to Liverpool with two suitcases and Andrea only 3 years old. First winter I cried every night because of the cold and the dark at 4pm. But you said tiis lang, we will be ok. And we are ok. More than ok. Thank you Lord for this man. Love you mahal ko, even if you still cannot fold a fitted sheet ❤️

Today one of my mums from 2008 stopped me in Asda in Walton and said Rosario you delivered this one!! and the 'baby' is now taller than me, starting sixth form 😭😭 I nearly cried by the bananas. This is why I love my job even with the long hours and the paperwork and the car park at Fazakerley. 22 years a midwife in this city and it still gets me every time. To all my mums, thank you for trusting me on your biggest day. Off to bed now, early clinic tomorrow 😴

Hello mga kabayan! Just a reminder for our newly arrived nurses and midwives, if you need help with the council tax forms or opening the bank account, message me or Jun, we are happy to help. Don't be shy, we all been there. When I came in 2004 nobody told me anything, I paid the wrong bill for 3 months haha. Also please get a proper winter coat, not the one from Divisoria 😂 Liverpool wind is no joke. Welcome to all of you, you are not alone here. God bless ❤️

Proud mum moment!! Andrea got her first job offer, junior designer in Manchester 🎉 She say mum don't post it, so of course I am posting it hehe. Sorry anak. From the little girl who drew on my nursing books to this. We are so proud of you!! Now who will eat my adobo on a Sunday, ha? You better come home every weekend, I will keep your room exactly the same, even the posters 😂 Love you anak, go get them ❤️
